name: Husqvarna 130
blurb: 14″ and 16″ bars on 3/8″ low-profile .050″ chain: 52 drive links on the 14″; Husqvarna's own 2026 guide contradicts itself on the 16″ (56 or 66), so we flag that row.
intro: The Husqvarna 130 is a rear-handle gas saw. Husqvarna's own 2026 Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide (effective 1 January 2026) lists 2 approved bar lengths for it (14″ and 16″), running 3/8″ low-profile pitch chain in .050″ gauge. One 16″ row in the guide contradicts its own part numbers (see the note on that row), so that row is flagged rather than repeated.

bars.note: Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 14″ setup with bar Laminate 596009752 and chain S93G X-Cut 585422152.

Husqvarna's 2026 guide is internally inconsistent for this row: the drive-link column prints 66, but the bar (596009756) and chain (585422156) part numbers it lists are the 56-link parts used for the 120 Mark II, 135 Mark II and 240 at 16″. We don't print a single number for it — count the drive links on your bar stamp.

sources.title: Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide 2026 (effective 1 January 2026) — certified/approved bar and chain combinations per saw

sources_note: Husqvarna 2026 Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide (effective 1 January 2026), read in full on 24 Oct 2026; every row in the table is restated from the saw's entry in that guide.
